intro.fr: Crab Champions se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Crab Champions can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Str8UpWHITE64/CrabChampionsAP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Crab Champions.
text.en: The GitHub repository Str8UpWHITE64/CrabChampionsAP, home of the Crab Champions APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 1.4.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (13 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 1.4.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (13 versions released).

text.fr: Crab Champions figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Crab Champions is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
